lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都枯萎了
lines.en: Where I walk, the grass withers
I'm thin; bone holds the skin up

lines.zh: 我一步一步，不快也不慢
lines.en: I walk step by step, neither fast nor slow

lines.zh: 我的脚踩过田野，土变灰
lines.en: My feet cross the field and the soil greys

lines.zh: 我不跑，我知道你跑不过我
lines.en: I don't run; I know I'll catch you
My hands hang long

lines.zh: 枯草在我脚边一寸寸发黄。
lines.en: The dead grass yellows inch by inch at my feet.
I walk in your footprints

lines.zh: 我经过的树上没有叶子
lines.en: The trees I pass have no leaves

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很轻，几乎听不见
lines.en: My breathing is faint, almost inaudible
I go around a heap of dry grass

lines.zh: 我一直朝你走，从不转向
lines.en: I always walk toward you, never turning
I stand like dead wood
I keep my head slightly bowed
The field beyond starts to grey
I'm counting the rise of your chest
I lift a hand, then let it fall

lines.zh: 爬墙也躲不掉，我跟着你。
lines.en: Climb the walls—I still follow.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里有一点点声音
lines.en: A faint sound sits in my throat

lines.zh: 我没有别的想去的地方
lines.en: There's nowhere else I want to go

lines.zh: 活物的气味钻进我鼻腔
lines.en: The smell of the living reaches me

lines.zh: 我饿得只剩骨头，还会爬墙。
lines.en: Starved to bone, and I still climb walls.

lines.zh: 我脚下长出了一点枯黄
lines.en: A patch of blight grows at my feet
My patience is long; I'm in no rush
Wind pushes dead leaves to my feet
I never need to close my eyes
You've turned around
I've been standing here a while
You're nearer than yesterday
Don't run; it will be quick
I smell your blood
My head tilts

lines.zh: 你看着我的脸，什么也读不出
lines.en: You search my face and find nothing
This land is already dead

lines.zh: 你没有注意到草都枯了
lines.en: You didn't notice the grass died
I've stood in your shadow
Back away; I'm in no hurry
One more step and I move
Your eyes are good

lines.zh: 饿着追到这里，只剩这点路。
lines.en: Starving, I chased to here, only this much left.
I want to hear you speak
Try smiling
It's fine if you strike first
I want you to keep talking

lines.zh: 我退了半步，动作没有变
lines.en: I step back and my movement doesn't change
The blade draws no blood
I stop and tilt my head
A little ash falls off me
I straighten up again
The grass around us withers faster
I make no sound

lines.zh: 我低头看了看你打的地方
lines.en: I look down where you struck
My motion lags a beat

lines.zh: 刀口很快合拢，我继续迈步。
lines.en: The cut closes fast; I keep walking.
There's something alive on you
I smell grain
Put that down
I won't eat it; I only want to be near
This soil is hungry
Feed it and it turns grey

lines.zh: 我伸手，不是要你的东西
lines.en: I reach out, and not for your goods
This ground is already caving
Keep that thing

lines.zh: 我只是想看看它还活着
lines.en: I only want to see it still living

lines.zh: 你撞上来，只碰到一片凉
lines.en: You hit me and meet only cold
My hand steadies you, lightly

lines.zh: 饿到能爬墙，就别往上躲。
lines.en: Hungry enough to climb. Don't hide up there.
You pass through the blight around me
The bump makes me slow
I catch your sleeve
You duck under my arm

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，土塌了一块
lines.en: We collide and a patch of earth gives way
I ease my fingers open
You go around me

lines.zh: 远处有另一个瘦长的影子
lines.en: Another gaunt shape stands far off
Neither of us needs words
It's as hungry as I am

lines.zh: 我们并肩走，草一起枯萎
lines.en: We walk side by side and the grass wilts
It's older than I am
We both check our steps

lines.zh: 这片田野正在变成我们的
lines.en: This field is becoming ours
It reaches out and I take its hand
We make no sound
Soon there will be more of us

lines.zh: 我俯下枯瘦的身子去拿
lines.en: I stoop my wasted body to take it
It withers in my hand
I hold it up to my hollow eyes
The moisture leaves it

lines.zh: 我把它放下，它已经没用
lines.en: I set it down; it's useless now
I hold it gently, so it won't crumble
This was alive once
I put it back in the soil
It makes this place greyer
I don't want it

lines.zh: 你终于动了一下，饥饿原野在动。
lines.en: You finally moved, and the Starved Fields stir.
I turn my body toward you
The field begins to wither my way
I never need to run

lines.zh: 我抬起枯瘦的手，指向你。
lines.en: I raise my gaunt hand and point at you.
I raise a hand and point at you
You hide behind a tree, and the tree dies
Climb high and I'll climb too
This area is mine already

lines.zh: 我踩过的田，土都变灰了。
lines.en: The field I cross turns grey under my feet.
I've started walking
You give a step; I take one
There's no road behind you either
I know you now
I've waited for this day
No one's coming for you
I trail you, step for step
You circle; I don't
I pass through a fence and the wood dies

lines.zh: 你爬上去，我抓着土壁跟
lines.en: You climb; I follow up the dirt wall
My shadow sticks to your feet
The grass draws back

lines.zh: 你不回头，我也知道你在哪
lines.en: Without looking, I know where you are
I herd you toward open ground
The open ground will only grow emptier
You're counting what strength you have
I needn't count it

lines.zh: 每过一会儿，地面就干一点
lines.en: Every so often the ground dries a little more

lines.zh: 你听，风里没有别的声音
lines.en: Listen; there's nothing else in the wind
I'm ten paces from you
Nine steps remain

lines.zh: 你数着退路，我只数步子。
lines.en: You count escape routes; I count only steps.
I'm not hurried, and I don't tire
Almost upon you
My hand settles on your shoulder

lines.zh: 我的指尖一碰，那块布就烂了
lines.en: My fingertips touch it and the cloth rots

lines.zh: 这一下很慢，你没有躲开
lines.en: It was slow, and you didn't dodge
My withered hand clamps your wrist
You're pressed down and the ground splits
My knuckles grind against you

lines.zh: 你退开，皮肤上留了一块灰
lines.en: You pull back with a grey patch on your skin
I wrap around you from behind
That one misses
You cut me and no blood comes
My arm stretches longer
I press you into the dead grass
Your strength is draining away
I lower my face toward yours

lines.zh: 你听见我喉咙里的声音
lines.en: You hear the sound in my throat
I let go and step back

lines.zh: 田野边缘的草开始变灰
lines.en: The grass at the field's edge begins to grey

lines.zh: 我站起来了，在地平线上
lines.en: I stand up on the horizon
The air here has gone dry

lines.zh: 先是一点枯黄，然后是我
lines.en: First a patch of blight, then me
My shadow arrives before I do
Every living thing here has gone quiet

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝有声音的地方走
lines.en: I walk slowly toward the sound
I ate this place bare long ago
The soil sags a little under me
My outline is that of a dead tree
There's a lamp; I see it
I don't hide; I never hide
I come on, step by step
Wind pushes dead leaves to your door

lines.zh: 你先听见的是草的声音
lines.en: The first thing you hear is the grass
I pause and raise my head
This land needs to be emptied
I've come; you should go

lines.zh: 火烧着我，我的皮像枯叶一样卷
lines.en: Fire takes me and my skin curls like dead leaves

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，骨头错了位
lines.en: I fall from a height and a bone slips out

lines.zh: 水灌进我，我第一次觉得重
lines.en: Water fills me; for once I feel heavy

lines.zh: 爆风把我吹散成一团灰
lines.en: The blast blows me apart into ash
The arrow sinks in like rotwood

lines.zh: 魔法烧着我身体里的枯意
lines.en: Magic burns the blight inside me

lines.zh: 这一片已经被我吃空了
lines.en: I've eaten this land empty

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我整个亮了一瞬
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I light up once

lines.zh: 下面没有土地，我抓不住
lines.en: No soil below; I can't hold on
